title: Attention is Not All You Need: Pure Attention Loses Rank Doubly Exponentially with Depth
relevance: Pure-attention depth-collapse theorem is foundational overlap.
novelty_threat: High for a generic repeated-attention collapse claim.
limitations: Pure attention omits residual and MLP mechanisms; token rank is not retained-history dimension.

title: Signal Propagation in Transformers: Theoretical Perspectives and the Role of Rank Collapse
relevance: Rank collapse and gradient propagation connect spectra to transformer design.
novelty_threat: Medium: spectral diagnosis is established.
limitations: Initialization and training signal propagation differ from fixed-weight periodic inference.

title: Setting the Record Straight on Transformer Oversmoothing
venue: arXiv preprint; conference status not verified
relevance: Value/projection spectra distinguish smoothing from sharpening.
novelty_threat: High against universal transformer smoothing.
limitations: Sec.3 analyzes fixed attention and weight matrices; dynamic attention and task-memory loss require separate tests.

title: Deep Equilibrium Models
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32 (NeurIPS 2019)
relevance: Input-conditioned equilibrium models establish useful convergent tied-depth computation.
novelty_threat: High against contraction necessarily erasing input.
limitations: Root-finding and implicit differentiation are not temporal periodic forcing; full implementation was not audited.

title: Universal Transformers
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Recurrent attention and adaptive per-position halting predate current looped models.
novelty_threat: Low for periodic memory; high for novelty of depth recurrence.
limitations: Step encoding and halting can make the effective iteration nonautonomous.

title: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Parameter sharing is architectural context for tied-depth controls.
novelty_threat: Low: architecture context.
limitations: Sharing alone does not establish arbitrary test-time looping or periodic memory dynamics.

title: Block-Recurrent Transformers
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Block-wise temporal attention recurrence provides the bounded-state comparator.
novelty_threat: Medium for architecture scope.
limitations: Persistent vectors and any local cache must both count as state; blocks determine the recurrence clock.

title: Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Constructed looped transformers execute programs and iterative algorithms.
novelty_threat: High against inevitable failure of all repeated blocks.
limitations: Hand-programmed expressivity is not a prediction of trained models or finite-precision memory.

title: On Expressive Power of Looped Transformers: Theoretical Analysis and Enhancement via Timestep Encoding
relevance: Approximation analysis motivates loop-dependent scaling through timestep encoding.
novelty_threat: Medium for interpreting loop-count effects.
limitations: Loop-index conditioning changes the map; approximation power does not prove memory preservation.

title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach
venue: arXiv preprint; final venue not reverified
relevance: Huginn documents recurrence-induced token collapse and state-ignoring training failures.
novelty_threat: High for generic recurrent-transformer collapse diagnosis.
limitations: Failure evidence concerns training/initialization; per-loop cache policy and repeated input change state and sensitivity.
version_note: Inspected/downloaded arXiv v1 is pinned; its PDF title page agrees with the canonical title. Current unversioned arXiv URLs resolve to v2.

title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
relevance: Controlled recurrent reasoners relate finite-time dynamics and task extrapolation.
novelty_threat: Very high for spectra-plus-task generality.
limitations: Top-eight exponents and projected non-normality are partial estimates; input remains available each step.

title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models
relevance: Retrofitted latent loops use gating, detached supervision and adaptive stopping.
novelty_threat: High for gated loop stabilization.
limitations: Convex interpolation does not prove contraction; inference cache semantics need implementation verification.

title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Structured linear state spaces supply cross-modal long-memory baselines.
novelty_threat: Low for periodic novelty; important analytical control.
limitations: Linear transition submodule differs from a stacked nonlinear model; frozen full-state tests are needed.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Input-dependent selection explicitly regulates retention and forgetting.
novelty_threat: Medium for a general cross-modal recurrence claim.
limitations: Token-conditioned coefficients and convolution history are part of complete dynamics.

title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Structured state-space duality connects attention-like operators and Mamba-2.
novelty_threat: Medium: attention-versus-SSM separation is already qualified.
limitations: Operator equivalence does not make all architectures share the same nonlinear full-state Jacobian.

title: RWKV-7 "Goose" with Expressive Dynamic State Evolution
relevance: Dynamic delta-rule state evolution is relevant to persistent categorical memory.
novelty_threat: Medium against blanket recurrent incapacity.
limitations: RWKV-7 differs from RWKV-4 used in routing-collapse work; implementation and state accounting need separate review.

title: xLSTM: Extended Long Short-Term Memory
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Scalar and matrix memories provide contrasting gated memory mechanisms.
novelty_threat: Medium for recurrence-wide claims.
limitations: Cell, hidden, normalizer and stabilization states cannot be reduced to output activations.

title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
relevance: Combines adaptive erasure and targeted delta updates, with retrieval and extrapolation tests.
novelty_threat: Medium for memory loss mechanisms.
limitations: Gated DeltaNet, hybrid variants and ungated DeltaNet must not be conflated.

title: Repeat After Me: Transformers are Better than State Space Models at Copying
venue: arXiv preprint; conference venue not reverified
relevance: Copying lower bounds separate fixed-state capacity from context access.
novelty_threat: High competing explanation for long-horizon failure.
limitations: Arbitrary string copying exceeds the proposed fixed-number-of-tags task; precision and cache resources matter.

title: Demystifying the Token Dynamics of Deep Selective State Space Models
relevance: Analyzes deep selective-state-space token convergence and performance interventions.
novelty_threat: High for new SSM token-dynamics claims.
evidence_locator: arXiv v2 Secs.3–5, Theorems4.1/4.3/4.4; ICLR paper
limitations: Main theory is a scalar S6 depth-continuum surrogate; not exact full-state temporal periodic recurrence. Primary sources use author-name variants.

title: All Routes Lead to Collapse
relevance: Claims shared low-rank routing signature with Mamba/RWKV interventions.
novelty_threat: Very high for architecture-general collapse.
limitations: Key-cloud rank is not task memory. Appendix B.4 token-permutation null is spectrum-invariant as written; code unverified. Source author given only as K. R. Balasubramanian.

title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers
relevance: Autonomous versus recall analysis includes fixed-point input sensitivity.
novelty_threat: Very high for proposed continuous-memory or reinjection theory.
evidence_locator: arXiv v1 Secs.3–5, Props.1–5; Appendices A.3,A.6–A.8
limitations: Smooth transversality assumptions exclude designed neutral manifolds; isolated fixed points can retain categorical labels by basin.

title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
relevance: Convergence-based adaptive halting and residual scaling give competing successful dynamics.
novelty_threat: High against useful computation requiring nonconvergence.
limitations: Input-conditioned puzzle reasoning is not delayed streaming recall; main design sections only, not full theorem audit.

title: MeSH: Memory-as-State-Highways for Recursive Transformers
relevance: Direct recursive hidden-state singular-spectrum collapse diagnosis and explicit-memory mitigation.
novelty_threat: Very high; closest architecture-specific dimensional-collapse prior.
evidence_locator: arXiv v1 Secs.2,3.2,4.1; Figs.1,5. Acceptance verified by arXiv v2 comment; v2 Sec.3.2/Figs.1,5 also checked.
limitations: Top-50 normalized token singular values omit full-state history geometry; step-specific routers change the map and buffer changes state budget.

title: Rank, Head-Channel Non-Identifiability, and Symmetry Breaking: A Precise Analysis of Representational Collapse in Transformers
relevance: Recent preprint distinguishes algebraic rank, residual effects and head identifiability.
novelty_threat: Medium: challenges loose collapse definitions.
limitations: Abstract/intro claims only checked; exact-rank and LayerNorm assertions require proof audit and must not be treated as effective-rank guarantees.
